project_type: macOS AVB audio bridge: C++ DriverKit dext (PCIDriverKit, Intel I210) + Rust cargo workspace (sans-IO protocol library crates, an avb-daemon binary, the existing avb-probe CLI and avb-installer app)
language: Rust 1.99.0 (edition 2021) for everything in crates/; C++20 / DriverKit 25.5 SDK (arm64e) for driver/
build_system: cargo workspace at /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/Cargo.toml (members listed explicitly; add each new crate to [workspace].members). rust-toolchain.toml pins channel 1.99.0-aarch64-apple-darwin (host-qualified on purpose: the rustup proxy runs under Rosetta). Dexts build with xcodebuild from driver/AVBI210Driver.xcodeproj and driver/AVBBcmDriver.xcodeproj (each has one scheme named like the project). QUIRK: xcodebuild rejects -derivedDataPath together with -target ('-scheme ... is required when specifying -derivedDataPath'); use -scheme <proj> -derivedDataPath /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tmp/DerivedData and keep SYMROOT=/Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/build/driver OBJROOT=/Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/build/driver/obj (verified: BUILT_PRODUCTS_DIR stays build/driver/Debug-driverkit). scripts/package.sh builds both dexts, cargo --release --locked, assembles build/AVBInstaller.app, stamps a kext-style CFBundleVersion, checks the dext is arm64e and signs inside-out.
test_framework: Rust: built-in #[test] (std only, no dev-dependencies may be added). C++: hand-rolled CHECK() host tests in driver/tests/{i210logic_tests.cpp,tg3logic_tests.cpp} built by driver/tests/Makefile with xcrun clang++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Werror into .agents/tmp/driver-tests.
verification_instructions:
Build gate (design §6.4, CRT-4), all with TMPDIR=/Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tmp/ and no cd: (1) cargo fmt --manifest-path /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/Cargo.toml --all --check; (2) cargo clippy --manifest-path /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings; (3) cargo test --manifest-path /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/Cargo.toml --workspace --locked; (4) make -C /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/driver/tests test (expects 'all i210 tests passed' and the tg3 pass line); (5) both dext builds with 0 warnings: /usr/bin/xcodebuild -project /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/driver/

.xcodeproj -scheme

-configuration Debug -sdk driverkit -derivedDataPath /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tmp/DerivedData SYMROOT=/Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/build/driver OBJROOT=/Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/build/driver/obj CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build for P in AVBI210Driver, AVBBcmDriver (grep the log for ' warning: ' -> must be none); (6) /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/scripts/package.sh --adhoc ends with 'packaged: .../build/AVBInstaller.app'. Record every command and its result (pass counts, warning counts) in /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tasks/phase1a-impl-verification.md (append a section per FEAT). Hardware ([HW]) items are NOT verified in software steps and must not be claimed (VER-5).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Cargo.lock is checked in and must be updated (offline, no new downloads) when new crates/direct edges are added: run cargo build --manifest-path /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/Cargo.toml --workspace --offline once (without --locked) after editing Cargo.toml files, then commit Cargo.lock; every later build/test uses --locked. All deps already exist in Cargo.lock: anyhow 1.0.104, clap 4.6.7, serde 1.0.229, serde_json 1.0.151, io-kit-sys 0.5.0, core-foundation-sys 0.8.7, mach2 0.7.0, libc 0.2.190. Build outputs build/ and target/ are gitignored. Captured test vectors go under crates/<crate>/tests/vectors/ (checked in).
environment_constraints: Never read/write /tmp, /private/tmp or system $TMPDIR: set TMPDIR=/Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tmp/ for cargo/rustc/xcodebuild/clang/codesign; mktemp -p /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tmp. Never cd/pushd: use cargo --manifest-path, git -C /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio, make -C, absolute paths; the shell cwd parameter may only be /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio. Never push; commit locally on branch phase1a-listener. No sudo, csrutil, nvram, bputil, systemextensionsctl in code or scripts. Software FEAT steps must NOT run real-hardware milestones (dedicated hw steps follow). Never touch any PCI device other than 8086:1533 / subsystem 1ab6:0214 (the Broadcom is on Apple's driver). Offline: no new crates may be downloaded.
contribution_requirements: User decisions (do not deviate): LISTENER ONLY (talker-ready boundaries per design §12, no talker built); start at 48 kHz, 44.1 kHz only if the AEM advertises it; NEVER hardcode rates, channel counts or stream counts outside tests (the only allowed literals: S_max = 16, the 1722 nsr code table, the class A 125 us observation interval; rate thresholds are §10.5 durations converted with the model rate/spf); receive ALL 16R AAF STREAM_OUTPUTs; our daemon is the AVDECC controller (ADP/AECP/ACMP CONNECT_RX), no external controller; gPTP priority1 = 255, the 16R is GM, our port never sends Announce/Sync/Follow_Up; dependency versions pinned exactly with '=' and only the eight crates in design §6.3; NO GPL/LGPL-derived code, comments, tables or struct layouts (Linux igb/igb_avb, OpenAvnu kernel parts, L-Acoustics avdecc, etc.) - encodings come from IEEE/Avnu texts and our own vectors, numbers marked *(verify)* carry a citation comment and a pinning unit test. Dext safety: no new register writes; only the four new statistics reads (CRCERRS 0x04000, MPC 0x04010, RNBC 0x040A0, RQDPC(0) 0x0C030) cited in I210Regs.h; RQDPC(0) added to the ReadReg32 denylist. If the only way forward changes user-visible behavior or an access control (e.g. removing the CopyClientEntitlements check, growing S_max, dropping a stream), stop and send_message severity 'warning'. Commit messages: conventional commits (feat(...)/fix(...)/docs(...)), record what was run. The design is approved: implement it faithfully, do not re-decide architecture; record any forced deviation under 'Deviations' in /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tasks/phase1a-impl-verification.md.
key_patterns: Design doc /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tasks/phase1a-design.md is the spec (section numbers referenced everywhere). Dext: all hardware access serialized on the driver default queue; AVBI210UserClient::ExternalMethod validates with an IOUserClientMethodDispatch kDispatch[] table and Forward() runs HandleUserMethod via DispatchSync_f; pure helpers live in I210Logic.hpp as constexpr/inline functions in a namespace and are host-tested in driver/tests/i210logic_tests.cpp with CHECK(); registers are named constexprs in I210Regs.h with 333016 section comments; setFault(v, code, why) is the single fault latch; atomics via __atomic builtins (no <atomic>). Rust: avb-probe/src/abi.rs mirrors AVBShared.h with #[repr(C)] structs + offset_of!/size_of tests; iokit.rs Device wraps IOConnectCallMethod with kr_check() mapping kIOReturn names; nic.rs NicProfile (uses freq.rs) selects the service. Protocol crates are sans-IO: handle_rx(now, frame, meta) -> Result<(), DropReason>, poll(now, &mut Outbox), next_deadline(); time is injected (avb_core::MachTicks/Timebase), no clocks/threads/IO outside avb-dext and avb-daemon (sole exception AudioRing::new_anonymous mmap). clippy::indexing_slicing denied in protocol crates. Logs to stderr prefixed 'avb-daemon[<subsys>]:'.
directory_structure: driver/ (AVBShared.h ABI header shared by both dexts and mirrored in Rust; AVBI210Driver/ the I210 dext: Driver.cpp ~1240 lines with setClock@290, harvestRx@631, checkTx@698, shutdownDatapath@755, initDatapath@775, sendFrame@836, TimerFired@1050, HandleUserMethod@1079; AVBBcmDriver/ legacy BCM dext kept as compile-regression only; tests/ C++ host tests + Makefile). crates/ (avb-probe: Phase 0/0b CLI with abi/iokit/nic/freq/ptp/stats/report modules; avb-installer: OSSystemExtensionRequest activator). scripts/package.sh. packaging/ (Info.plist + entitlements). docs/ (phase results). .agents/tasks/ (tracked design/plan/review/verification docs). .agents/tmp/ (gitignored scratch). build/, target/ gitignored. New in Phase 1a: crates/avb-core, avb-dext, avb-gptp, avb-srp, avb-avtp, avb-avdecc, avb-mediaclock, avb-audioring, avb-daemon; packaging/daemon.entitlements.
